title: A Walk Through Zürich
intro: A small showcase for the Maps Walker engine. You walk a character through Zürich, streamed live as real 3D tiles, reach the glowing beacons, and catch a plane up to a viewpoint over the city. Each stage exercises a different engine feature; open public/game.json to see how it's put together. Progress saves in the browser.
ending: That's the whole tour: walking, a companion who waits for you, a collectible, a rhythm minigame, a drivable car, a night scene, and a plane that teleports you. All of it comes from one JSON file. Fork it, drop in your own city and story, and press P any time to jump around. Thanks for playing.

quest.clueBody: You arrive at Zürich Hauptbahnhof, and your companion tags along. Head down the Bahnhofstrasse to Paradeplatz, in the middle of the banking district.
quest.arrivalBody: Trams cross in every direction and the chocolatiers are just around the corner. This stage covered the basics: a spawn point, a companion that follows you, and a plain clue that pays off with an arrival letter.

quest.clueBody: Your companion runs ahead to wait by the twin towers of the Grossmünster, across the river. Walk over and meet them there.
quest.arrivalBody: Your companion waves you over. This stage parked the companion at a fixed point with a forced wave animation, showed an image in the clue card, and granted a collectible to your HUD.

quest.clueBody: Follow the river a short way to the water's edge. A punt is waiting there; time your strokes to pole down the Limmat.
quest.arrivalBody: Water, sunlight, and a wobbly pole. Reaching this beacon launched a minigame in a modal before the arrival letter. Win it or skip it; the story continues either way.

quest.clueBody: Dusk has fallen. A car is parked nearby; press C to summon one if you don't see it, then E to get in. Drive up to the Lindenhof terrace above the old town.
quest.arrivalBody: Rooftops and the floodlit Grossmünster below. This stage rendered at night, mounted a drivable car, and used a wider per-stage trigger radius.

quest.clueBody: Down to Bürkliplatz on the lake. A little plane is waiting on the water (don't ask). Walk to it to board and fly up to the Uetliberg.
quest.travelNote: Wheels up over the lake, then a very short hop to the mountain.
quest.arrivalBody: The house mountain of Zürich, ~870 m up. This stage was a teleport: reaching the boarding beacon (with a plane parked on it and the companion hidden) faded to black, re-centered the world on the destination, and played a boarding sound.

quest.clueBody: Walk the last stretch to the Uetliberg viewpoint and look out over the whole city and lake.
quest.arrivalBody: Zürich, the lake, and the Alps on a clear day. That's every core feature of the engine, in six short stages. Now go build your own.
